text:
nina: quick flag while bringing up Galaxy's ledgerblend adapter (ledgerblend-lora v1.2). smoke-run on int4 shows sporadic deletion of trailing zeros and occasional currency symbol dropouts in ledger summaries. anyone have bandwidth?

raj: can you paste one failing output? short is fine.

nina: redacted example:

```
input: "Amount paid: $7,500.00"
expected: "Amount paid: $7,500.00"
model (fp16): "Amount paid: $7,500.00"
model (int4): "Amount paid: 7,500"  <-- lost $ and .00
```

mike: ugh. which tokenizer merge did you use? any grafted currency tokens?

nina: we grafted galaxy-ledger-toks on top of base-en-v4 to improve chunking for ledger lines. repro only when graft + int4. int8 and fp16 clean.

raj: run variants: grafted+int4 (default), grafted+int4+force-postproc, grafted+int8, base-only+int4. also collect token-streams.

eval-bot: kicked off quick evalpack (n=120). will report back.

eval-bot: results summary: grafted+int4: 13/120 currency-format errors; grafted+int4+force-postproc: 9/120; grafted+int8: 0/120; base-only+int4: 2/120. latency int4 ~ -16% vs fp16. artifacts: s3://redwood-eval/galaxy/ledgerblend-v1.2/1815554321/

mike: can you dump tokens for a failing sample (tokenize -> detok -> decoded tokens)?

nina: pasted one token trace:

```
# token ids (grafted): [34, 7001, 9998, 88, 405, 11]
# detok pre-postproc: "Amount paid: $ 7 500 . 0 0"
# postproc -> "$7,500.00"
# int4 decoded -> "Amount paid: 7,500"
```

raj: looks like the dollar token or its neighboring punctuation is being dropped in the decode under noisy logits. probably scoring prefers dropping the $ and final zero token because of tiny logit shifts after quant.

mike: two quick triage ideas: 1) add a decode-time bias (small additive logit) for currency/punct tokens when the decoder is inside a numeric span; 2) run a calibration sweep that includes grafted currency tokens so quant preserves their relative logit ordering.

nina: started a small beam experiment: beam=1 vs beam=4 with int4+force-postproc. will upload results.

eval-bot: beam test complete: beam=4 recovered 7/13; beam=1 recovered 3/13 with force-postproc. remaining 3 cases persist.

raj: so combined causes: grafted tokenization creates multi-token numeric spans, and int4 quant noise reduces logits for less-common graft tokens causing deletions. mitigation options: short-term pin Galaxy to int8 for canary; medium-term add decode bias and include grafted tokens in calibration; longer-term add a lightweight numeric-format unit test in graft merge CI (50 samples) so these regressions are caught pre-canary.

mike: agree. Also suggest adding an eval metric: numeric-preservation-rate on the customer's ledger set (target >= 99.5%) to gate canary.

nina: opening ticket ML-1427 with artifacts and token dumps: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/ML-1427. attaching s3 artifact.

eval-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-eval/galaxy/ledgerblend-v1.2/1815554321/ (token-streams, csv, logs).

deploy-bot: canary deployment for galaxy/ledgerblend-lora-v1.2 scheduled on stack-4 at 1815554360.

raj: I'll add the CI numeric-format test to the graft pipeline and schedule a calibration sweep. ping me if you need infra quota.

nina: thanks all. will pin to int8 for prod until calibration sweep completes. closing thread when ticket updates are done. :thumbsup:
